title: Lock It Down
style: Cyberpunk synth-pop at 135 BPM with driving four-on-the-floor drums, rubbery analog bass pulses, and jagged arps; verse rides a tight electro groove, pre-chorus strips to snare rolls and filtered claps, chorus hits with neon stack synths and gang shouts. Corey leads with close-mic verses, doubled hooks, and pitched ad-libs. Laser risers, reverse swells, and stadium-delay throws. Bright, aggressive, glossy mix., spoken word, clean, electronic, grime, new beat, noise, pop, world
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Checking out the registry
Staring at the screen
Looking for the greatest name
The world has ever seen

Sony had the crown
But they let it slip
2014 on the page
Now we make the shift

IR cancelled flashing
Like a warning sign
From the beaches of NZ
To the Aussie line

We don't wait around
We step through the door
Base is secured now
Tell me what you want

[Pre-Chorus]
We don't copy-paste
We draw the line
Cutting through the noise
Right on time

Ready on the portal
Ready for the strike
Corey on the mic
Saying what he like

One single filing
WIPO in the zone
Hands on the future
Claiming the throne

[Chorus]
SONGPAL
Lock it down
Take it from the ghost

ZYNTHIO
Rising up
Coast to global coast

MOSOKO
In the East
Dodging all the traps

KERVALON
Pure defense
Rewriting all the maps

Sing it back
Make the system shake
This is our empire
This is what we make

Lock it down
Lock it down
Yeah, we take it all

[Verse 2]
Now we cross the ocean
Land where the heat runs high
African markets moving
Under a sharper sky

OAPI in the West
Seventeen in line
One clean signature
And the whole thing shines

But we watch the wording
Keep it clean and tight
Class nine on the paper
Everything in sight

South Africa, Nigeria
Filing at the gates
We don't leave it to luck
We don't wait on fate

City after city
Pulse begins to rise
Every step we take
Feels like new design

[Pre-Chorus]
We don't copy-paste
We draw the line
Cutting through the noise
Right on time

Madrid Protocol
Send the signal wide
Corey on the mic
With the world outside

One single filing
WIPO in the zone
Hands on the future
Claiming the throne

[Chorus]
SONGPAL
Lock it down
Take it from the ghost

ZYNTHIO
Rising up
Coast to global coast

MOSOKO
In the East
Dodging all the traps

KERVALON
Pure defense
Rewriting all the maps

Make the system shake
This is our empire
This is what we make

Lock it down
Lock it down
Yeah, we take it all

[Bridge]
Priority dates
Locked in place

IP Australia
Cleared the space

IPONZ
Secured tonight

Corey says the name
Now it shines
